narr: Showers and isolated thunderstorms associated with an area of low pressure moving northward along the coast produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of northeast North Carolina.
ev: Mesonet site reported rainfall total of 6.76 inches since midnight. Rainfall total of 5.16 inches fell between 4 am and 10 am.
Water was overflowing a pond and covering the roadway near the intersection of Austin Street and Villa Court.
lsr: MESONET SITE REPORTING RAINFALL TOTAL OF 6.76 INCHES SINCE MIDNIGHT. 5.16 INCHES FELL BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AM.
WATER OVERFLOWING POND AND COVERING ROADWAY NEAR INTERSECTION OF AUSTIN ST AND VILLA CT.
